hints.title: Two Cup Pair Filling
hints.text: In each second, you can fill up to two cups of different types or one cup of any type.

hints.title: Dominant Cup Type Bottleneck
hints.text: If one cup type has more than the sum of the other two, it cannot be completely paired and forms the bottleneck.

hints.title: Equally Distributed Seconds
hints.text: Otherwise, all cups can be paired almost completely, taking ceiling of sum(amount) / 2 seconds.

hints.title: Mathematical Bound Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating one second increments is unnecessary when the optimal bound is closed form.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies the pigeonhole principle and writes concise closed form solution.
